name: Runway
tagline: Generative video and creative AI tools for images, video, and editing

pricing.notes: Official pricing checked 2026-07-30; Standard plan listed at $15/month monthly and $12/month annually in public pricing references.

verdictSummary: A UI around video models is buildable; the video-generation model quality, compute, safety, editing stack, and continuous research are not a solo afternoon project.
coreLoopDIY: Wrap open-source/video APIs to generate or edit clips, manage credits, and export assets.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay because generative video quality and inference infrastructure are the product.

priorArt.name: diffusers
priorArt.desc: Open-source library for diffusion models; useful for experimentation, not a Runway replace

notes: Important no for the frontier-model category.
prompt:
Honest answer: don't build Runway. The product is the video model, the compute behind
it, and continuous research. No prompt gives you that.

What you can build in an afternoon is a thin workbench over hosted models, which kills
the subscription if you only generate occasionally:

- A local web page on localhost:3300: Node + Express, a prompt box, a model picker, and
  a gallery of past generations.
- Generate via the Replicate API (token in .env) against current open video models
  (Wan/LTX/Hunyuan class), or fal.ai if it has the model you want, pick one provider and
  stick to it.
- Poll the job, download the mp4 to ~/generations/YYYY-MM-DD/, and record prompt, model,
  params, cost, and file path in SQLite (better-sqlite3).
- Image-to-video: upload a still and pass it as the conditioning frame.
- Show a month-to-date spend total from per-job cost so usage stays honest.
- No accounts, no telemetry; prompts and outputs stay local except the API calls
  themselves.
- Out of scope: editing timelines, inpainting, and anything realtime. You are renting a
  model, not owning one; quality and price move whenever the model list does.
- README: where to get the Replicate token and rough dollars per second of video on the
  default model.
